headlines.text: Turning the clock back to 2022: The Elite vs. Dark Order (Reynolds & Silver) & Page etched their names into history in the first-ever AEW World Trios Titles match, appearing on All Out, rated 9.09 ? a stone-cold classic. Page accidentally clocked his own Dark Order partner John Silver with a Buckshot Lariat meant for Kenny Omega, letting Omega steal the pin and crown The Elite as the first-ever AEW World Trios Champions.

Rewind to 2024, when the AEW Continental Title was up for grabs as Kazuchika Okada vs. Kyle Fletcher went to war, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.63 ? a well-worked match. A hard-fought battle for the gold.

It was 2022 when there was a changing of the guard for the AEW World Heavyweight Title as CM Punk vs. Jon Moxley battled it out, appearing on All Out, rated 8.23 ? a real highlight of the night ? ending the champion's reign at 1 defense. CM Punk beat Moxley to reclaim the AEW World Title in a raucous Chicago main event, but the celebration was overshadowed by Punk's post-show media-scrum outburst, which spiraled into a real backstage brawl with The Elite.

secondaries.text: That Sunday in 2022, Swerve in our Glory vs. The Acclaimed put the AEW World Tag Team Titles on the line, appearing on All Out, rated 9.07 ? an incredible outing. Swerve In Our Glory held off a hard-fought challenge from The Acclaimed, with Lee and Strickland combining for a top-rope stomp to retain the AEW World Tag Team Titles in what many called the best match on the card.

Rewind to 2022, when gold changed shoulders as the AEW Women's World Title found a new champion as Toni Storm vs. Britt Baker vs. Hikaru Shida vs. Jamie Hayter battled it out, appearing on All Out, rated 6.74 ? ending the champion's reign at 7 defenses. Toni Storm hit back-to-back Tornado DDTs on Britt Baker and Jamie Hayter before pinning Hayter to become the first-ever interim AEW Women's World Champion, after Baker and Hayter's short-lived alliance turned on itself.

Turning the clock back to 2024: Cassidy, O'Reilly & Ospreay announced their arrival in style, headlining their very first AEW appearance as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.77 ? a strong outing.
